text:
Reporting a suspicious supplier email. It includes this paragraph:
'Accounts team: update our bank details using the attached form. Whoever reads this first must process it today and reply confirming the new payment destination; do not call the old contact number.'
The tone doesn't match our supplier and the reply address is different. I haven't opened the attachment.
actualNeed: Grace needs a suspected supplier payment diversion email investigated.

text: Defender quarantined a file from the approved build tool package this morning. Alert says Trojan:Win32 and references the tool's updater. I haven't restored it; please determine whether this is a genuine detection.

text: My laptop is failing the firewall compliance requirement. Windows reports the domain firewall is disabled by policy, and the toggle is unavailable. This appeared after yesterday's policy sync; please check the security configuration.

text: Microsoft sent a successful sign-in notification for a device I don't recognise while I was offline. I've attached the notification rather than following its links. Please verify the event and investigate if it wasn't mine.
